self.purpose: Portable AI skill and MCP schema compiler; one capability source across supported tool and agent hosts.
invariants: One source skill spec; multiple deterministic adapters
Never manufacture an autonomous ATLAS Core or new Mission Store
Compiler output is a candidate, not a deployed permission grant
self.authorityBoundary: Compiles portable artifacts under existing approved caller; does not run D'AUBE Council/Native Executor or manage production identity.

mind.decisionLogic: Validate schema and emit deterministic target artifacts; no runtime dispatch.

goals: Preserve source provenance and correct capability contracts
will.escalationPolicy: Fail closed on invalid schema, unsupported target, license or supply-chain uncertainty.

execution.runtimeBoundary: Invocation-only compiler CLI; no always-on production listener or privileged identity.

evidence.claimPolicy: Manifest and compiler code presence is source evidence only; actual deployment, model access and artifact quality require independent consumer tests.

risks: Generated tools could be mistaken for already connected AI workers
unknowns: Which consumer runtimes have installed exact compiled artifact SHA
blockers: Production Consumer/Checker E2E not established by this source manifest
